claim: ACME Infra revises FY27 revenue growth guidance down to 6-8% from 10-12%
snippet: The Board has revised the revenue growth guidance for FY27 to 6-8% (earlier 10-12%) on account of delays in two large order executions.

claim: ACME Infra cuts FY27 revenue growth guidance to 6-8% from 10-12%
snippet: In an exchange filing this morning, ACME Infra lowered its revenue growth outlook, citing slower execution on two large orders.
